raw_text: Worth noting the coordinated messaging around the Chabahar deal from Iranian state media. Press TV, Tehran Times, and IRNA all pushing identical framing about India defying US sanctions. Multiple social media accounts amplifying the narrative targeting Western think-tank audiences and Indian strategic affairs commentators. This looks like a coordinated influence operation to shape the narrative around the agreement.
clean_text: Coordinated messaging from Iranian state media on Chabahar deal with identical framing about India defying US sanctions. Influence operation targets Western think-tanks and Indian strategic commentators.
